name: Stop Impulse Buying | Budget
description:
Revamp your shopping habits with STOP IMPULSE BUYING app, the ultimate tool to control impulsive spending and elevate your savings game. Designed for those battling online shopping addiction, Amazon impulse buys, and TikTok shop trends, and individuals aiming for financial resilience, STOP IMPULSE BUYING empowers you to make mindful buying and saving choices.


Key Features:

No Spend Challenge Tracker: 
• The No Spend Calendar Tracker helps you visually track your no-spend, no buy days, providing motivation to stay on budget by highlighting streaks and progress over time.

52-Week Challenge: 
• The 52-Week Savings Challenge helps you track and visualize your progress with an envelope-style savings planner, allowing you to incrementally save up to $1,378 over the course of the year.

Goal-Driven Savings:
• Define your financial objective, whether it's a dream vacation, debt reduction, or an emergency fund. STOP IMPULSE BUYING serves as your personalized guide to achieving shopping-related financial goals.

Decision-Making Guide:
• Prior to each purchase, engage with thought-provoking questions designed for careful consideration. STOP IMPULSE BUYING ensures you weigh the pros and cons, facilitating informed decisions aligned with your shopping and financial goals.

Buy Don't Buy Impulse Checklist:
• Receive a decisive recommendation from Stop Impulse Buying's impulsive purchase checklist tool based on your responses. Use Stop Impulse Buying's guidance to proceed with the purchase or resist the impulse, steering you toward a more intentional and mindful shopping experience.

Impulse Savings Tracker:
• Watch your savings grow as the app tracks every "DON'T BUY" decision. Celebrate your wins and see the positive impact on your budget over time.

Monthly Expense Tracker:
• Set a spending allowance, record your expenses, and track your progress monthly to see where your money goes.

BONUS: Grocery/Shopping List!
• We’ve added a fun tool to help you stick to your budget and buy only what you planned. Whether at the mall or grocery store, stay on track with your list!


Bid farewell to impulsive spending and embrace financial freedom with Stop Impulse Buying. Download now to take the first step toward savvy shopping, increased savings, and effortlessly achieving your shopping-related financial goals.


Subscription Pricing and Terms for Stop Impulse Buying:
Stop Impulse Buying offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $9.99/month and annual auto-renewing subscription at $49.99 (both with 7 day free trial to new users) to provide you with unlimited access to our app's features while your subscription remains active.

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your Apple account upon confirmation of the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be identified. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by accessing your App Store/Apple Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited upon subscription purchase, where applicable.
